arxiv-2011-10833.title: Tidal locking and the gravitational fold catastrophe
arxiv-2011-10833.creator: Andrea Ferroglia 1,2 and Miguel C. N. Fiolhais 3,4 1 The Graduate School and University Center, The City University of New York, 365 Fifth Avenue, New York, NY 10016, USA 2 Physics Department, New York City College of Technology, The City University of New York, 300 Jay Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201, U
arxiv-2011-10833.description: Abstract The purpose of this work is to study the phenomenon of tidal locking in a pedagogical framework by analyzing the effective gravitational potential of a two-body system with two spinning objects. It is shown that the effective potential of such a system is an example of a fold catastrophe.

arxiv-2110-12552.title: Noisy UGC Translation at the Character Level: Revisiting Open-Vocabulary Capabilities and Robustness of Char-Based Models
arxiv-2110-12552.creator: José Carlos Rosales Núñez, Guillaume Wisniewski, Djamé Seddah
arxiv-2110-12552.description: Abstract This work explores the capacities of character-based Neural Machine Translation to translate noisy User-Generated Content (UGC) with a strong focus on exploring the limits of such approaches to handle productive UGC phenomena, which almost by definition, cannot be seen at training time.

arxiv-2205-04583.creator: Antonio Orvieto, Simon Lacoste-Julien, Nicolas Loizou

arxiv-2207-01928.title: Study of an entropy dissipating finite volume scheme for a nonlocal cross-diffusion system
arxiv-2207-01928.creator: Maxime Herda, Antoine Zurek
arxiv-2207-01928.description: Abstract . In this paper we analyse a finite volume scheme for a nonlocal version of the Shigesada-Kawazaki-Teramoto (SKT) cross-diffusion system. We prove the existence of solutions to the scheme, derive qualitative properties of the solutions and prove its convergence.

arxiv-2207-12058.title: On the evolution of agricultural and non-agricultural produce flow network in India
arxiv-2207-12058.creator: Sujata S Kulkarni, Raviraj Dave, Udit Bhatia, Rohini Kumar
arxiv-2207-12058.description: Abstract Rising economic instability and continuous evolution in international relations demand a self-reliant trade and commodity flow networks at regional scales to efficiently address the growing human needs of a nation. Despite its importance in securing India’s food security, the potential advantages of inland trade remain unexplored.

arxiv-2304-07810.description: Abstract . In argumentative writing, writers must brainstorm hierarchical writing goals, ensure the persuasiveness of their arguments, and revise and organize their plans through drafting. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made interactive text generation through a chat interface (e.g., ChatGPT) possible.

arxiv-2407-15549.title: Latent Adversarial Training Improves Robustness to Persistent Harmful Behaviors in LLMs
arxiv-2407-15549.creator: * Abhay Sheshadri, Georgia Institute of Technology, MATS asheshadri31@gatech.edu, * Aidan Ewart, University of Bristol, MATS aidanprattewart@gmail.com, * Phillip Guo, University of Maryland, MATS phguo@umd.edu, * Aengus Lynch, University College London, MATS aenguslynch@gmail.com, * Cindy Wu, MATS w
arxiv-2407-15549.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) can often be made to behave in undesirable ways that they are explicitly fine-tuned not to. For example, the LLM red-teaming literature has produced a wide variety of ‘jailbreaking’ techniques to elicit harmful text from models that were fine-tuned to be harmless.

arxiv-2507-18381.title: On decoherence in surface hopping: the nonadiabaticity threshold
arxiv-2507-18381.creator: Johan E. Runeson
arxiv-2507-18381.description: Abstract This work presents a strategy to efficiently and safely account for decoherence in the fewest switches surface hopping method. Standard decoherence corrections often lead to too strong coherence suppression. A simple and general solution to this problem is to restrict decoherence to regions of low nonadiabaticity measured by the dimensionless Massey parameter.

pmc-11544850.title: Analysis of Predictive Factors Associated with Unsuccessful Sentinel Lymph Node Mapping in Endometrial Carcinoma
pmc-11544850.creator: Linas Andreika, Monika Šiaudinytė, Karolina Vankevičienė, Diana Ramašauskaitė, Vilius Rudaitis
pmc-11544850.description: Simple SummarySentinel lymph node (SLN) biopsy is recommended over systematic lymphadenectomy in early-stage endometrial cancer due to its lower morbidity and comparable detection rate. The objective of this study was to identify clinical factors associated with unsuccessful mapping. We conducted a prospective, single-institution study of 120 participants with early-stage uterine cancer.

pmc-11640767.title: Effect of Fatty Acids on Backfat Quality in Beijing Black Pigs
pmc-11640767.creator: Xueli Zhu, Weilong Tian, Ziping Hu, Renda Hou, Xinhua Hou, Ligang Wang, Longchao Zhang, Lei Pu, Lixian Wang, Xin Liu, Zuhaib Bhat
pmc-11640767.description: The quality of pig backfat affects both pork quality and consumer preferences. Fatty acids (FAs) are crucial in determining the backfat quality. This study assessed the effect of FAs on the backfat quality and identified candidate genes associated with these FAs.

pmc-12446885.title: Heterotopic Pregnancy After Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection With Viable Embryos: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-12446885.creator: Ioannis Boutas, Adamantia Kontogeorgi, Sofia-Maria Genitsaridi, Maria Sotiria Bompoula, Nektarios I Koufopoulos, Kyparissia Sitara, Dionysios T Dimas, Sophia Kalantaridou, Antonios Makrigiannakis, Magda Zanelli, Andrea Palicelli, Maurizio Zizzo, Giuseppe Broggi, Serena Salzano, Rosario Caltabiano, A
pmc-12446885.description: Heterotopic pregnancy is defined as the simultaneous presence of gestation in two different sites, typically comprising an intrauterine pregnancy and an ectopic pregnancy. Due to the widespread use of assisted reproductive technologies (ARTs), the incidence of heterotopic pregnancies has increased significantly.

pmc-12469675.title: Dietary Lysine Supplementation Above Requirement Improves Carcass Traits and Enhances Pork Flavor Profiles in Finishing Pigs Under Commercial Conditions
pmc-12469675.creator: Jialong Liao, Fengyi Song, Boyang Wan, Haijun Sun, Jingdong Yin, Xin Zhang
pmc-12469675.description: To explore the effects of dietary lysine level (DLLs) on growth performance, carcass traits, meat quality and flavor characteristics in finishing pigs under large-scale commercial farming conditions, approximately 450 Duroc × Landrace × Yorkshire crossbred finishing pigs (initial body weight: 103.65 ± 4.28 kg) were randomly assigned to four treatment groups in this study.

pmc-12578810.title: Millimeter-wave broadband dual-circularly polarized array antenna loaded with metasurface
pmc-12578810.creator: Ting Wu, Zikang Zhang
pmc-12578810.description: This paper presents a millimeter-wave broadband dual circularly polarized (DCP) linear array antenna loaded with a linear to circular polarization converting metasurface. The feeding element employs a circular patch into which a symmetric cross-shaped slot is etched, dividing the patch into four electrically isolated, equal-area sectors.

pmc-12582635.title: Severe Seronegative Myasthenia Gravis Revealed by Rapidly Progressive Dysphagia
pmc-12582635.creator: Christopher Ramos Huamancondor, Maroussia Bronchain, Jonathan Petit
pmc-12582635.description: Dysphagia as the initial symptom of a severe myasthenic crisis is an atypical but well-documented presentation in the literature. A woman in her 40s presented to the emergency department with rapidly progressive dysphagia, initially misdiagnosed as gastro-oesophageal reflux. Two weeks earlier, she had completed eradication therapy for Helicobacter pylori.

pmc-12698822.title: Mendelian analysis reveals novel pancreatic cancer-associated gut bacteria with tumor-suppressive effects
pmc-12698822.creator: Yi Tong, Qian Li, Wei Zhang, Xingli Fan, Hong Tu, Yu Gan
pmc-12698822.description: PurposeThe gut microbiota has been implicated in the development and progression of pancreatic cancer (PC), yet few specific bacterial species have been reported to exert functional effect on PC. This study aimed to identify novel PC-associated gut bacterial species with tumor-regulatory effects and explore the potential molecular mediators of their effect.

pmc-13051084.title: Machine learning-based DNA microarray analysis for disease detection using the MICRO-AI framework
pmc-13051084.creator: Manal A Othman
pmc-13051084.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). DNA microarray is a transformative technique in genomics, enabling simultaneous examination of thousands of gene expression levels. However, noise, high dimensionality (typically 12,000–22,000 genes), small sample sizes (155–1097 samples) and class imbalance complicate the extraction of meaningful diagnostic patterns. This paper presents MICRO-AI (Microarray Classification and Recognition using Artificial Intelligence), a comprehensive machine learning framework for DNA microarray analysis and automated disease diagnosis.

pmc-13339076.title: CYP2C19 Genotype is Associated with Citalopram Treatment Outcomes in a Real‐World Setting
pmc-13339076.creator: Yoomi Park, Yitian Zhou, Volker M. Lauschke
pmc-13339076.description: CYP2C19 metabolizes various selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) and genetic CYP2C19 variants are associated with SSRI tolerability and response. Yet, whether CYP2C19 variability also impacts citalopram response remained unclear. We here evaluated associations between CYP2C19 genotypes and citalopram prescription data of 11,079 patients from the UK Biobank.
